passages.name: Line 1
passages.text:
Wilfred: Brilliant. Now I am stuck in a cage that is glued to the ceiling.
[[Line 2]]

passages.name: Line 2
passages.text:
Wilfred: (How is Meone handling this!? She is the more skittish one.)
[[Line 3]]

passages.name: Line 3
passages.text:
Wilfred: (And here I am, losing my cool! I must look pathetic right now... but it's not my fault.)
[[Line 4]]

passages.name: Line 4
passages.text:
Wilfred: This is all Wini's fault! She fell for such an obvious trap!
[[Line 5]]

passages.name: Line 5
passages.text:
Wilfred: Wini was always hopeless on her own. Always needed me around to stop her from getting into messes such as these.
[[Line 6]]

passages.name: Line 6
passages.text:
Wilfred: (Why did she get the witch powers? She has never used them for anything good...)
[[Line 7]]

passages.name: Line 7
passages.text:
Wilfred: (But, I don't want her to die! So I have to get out of this cage and find her!)
[[Line 8]]

passages.name: Line 8
passages.text:
Wilfred: Well... it looks like Wilfred has to save the day again. I'll get us out of here Meone!
[[Line 9]]

passages.name: Line 9
passages.text:
Wilfred: You'll forgive Wini when we find her, right Meone? Even if she did kill mo- AAAH!
[[Line 10]]

passages.name: Line 10
passages.text: Wilfred: What a stroke of luck! Come on Meone! Let us be off before that crazy doctor comes back!
